* **Terms of Service:**
  > *"These Terms of Use constitute a legally binding agreement made between you... and (Metaview Global Limited, “Metaview”, “we”, “us”, or “our”)... governing the use of our Site (https://metaview.ai), products, software, services and web application (collectively the “Services”). * **Website Terms of Use:**
  > *"Metaview Global Ltd is a company registered in England and Wales (company number: 11313397) with its registered address at Floor 8, 4 Elder Street, London E1 6BT (“Metaview,” “we,” “our,” or “us”). Metaview operates the www.metaview.ai website..."*

  > *"The Metaview entity responsible for your personal data depends on how you interact with us and where you are located: If you are located in the EEA, the United Kingdom, or Switzerland, Metaview Global Ltd... is the data controller. If you are located in the United States or elsewhere, Metaview Labs Inc (incorporated in Delaware) is the data controller."* The website footer is additionally copyrighted by *Metaview Labs Inc.*.
